fullPassage: Water availability is a major agricultural concern in India, especially for cultivation of rice. Since only 44 percent of the country's agricultural land is irrigated, millions of rice growers must rely on annual monsoons. Over the past 30 years, though, India's farmers have faced challenges as extreme weather events during the monsoon season—including droughts—have become more frequent. Water-use plans are one tool being used to help thirsty regions. In 2009, the Indian government began a national watershed management program to promote more efficient water use through education and technical support. Another innovation: Substantial progress has been made in developing hybrid rice varieties that grow faster while using less water. A new drought-resistant basmati rice variety matures about 30 days earlier than previous crossbred varieties. Farmers across India are already praising the high-yielding variety.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>frequent</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: frequent(잦은)의 반대말은 rare(드문).
det.analysis:
❌ ① regular(규칙적인): 빈도가 아니라 규칙성에 관한 말이라 반대말이 아니에요.

❌ ② common(흔한): frequent와 비슷한 뜻이라 반대말이 아니에요.

✅ ③ rare(드문): frequent는 '잦은'이라서 반대말은 '드문' rare예요. ← 정답

❌ ④ repeated(반복되는): 잦은 것과 비슷한 뜻이라 반대말이 아니에요.
det.tip: frequent(잦은)↔rare(드문)

questions.passage: Water availability is a major agricultural concern in India, especially for cultivation of rice. Since only 44 percent of the country's agricultural land is irrigated, millions of rice growers must rely on annual monsoons. Over the past 30 years, though, India's farmers have faced challenges as extreme weather events during the monsoon season—including droughts—have become more frequent. Water-use plans are one tool being used to help thirsty regions. In 2009, the Indian government began a national watershed management program to promote more <u>efficient</u> water use through education and technical support. Another innovation: Substantial progress has been made in developing hybrid rice varieties that grow faster while using less water. A new drought-resistant basmati rice variety matures about 30 days earlier than previous crossbred varieties. Farmers across India are already praising the high-yielding variety.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>efficient</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: efficient(효율적인)의 반대말은 wasteful(낭비하는).
det.analysis:
❌ ① productive(생산적인): efficient와 비슷한 긍정적 뜻이라 반대말이 아니에요.

✅ ② wasteful(낭비하는): efficient는 '효율적인'이라서 반대말은 '낭비하는' wasteful이에요. ← 정답

❌ ③ effective(효과적인): efficient와 비슷한 뜻이라 반대말이 아니에요.

❌ ④ systematic(체계적인): 효율과 비슷한 긍정적 뜻이라 반대말이 아니에요.
det.tip: efficient(효율적인)↔wasteful(낭비하는)

questions.passage:
(A) Water availability is a major agricultural <u>concern</u> in India, especially for cultivation of rice.

(B) Parents show great <u>concern</u> for their children's education and future success.
questions.stem: (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 concern의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A)는 물 이용이 '사안/문제'라는 뜻, (B)는 부모가 보이는 '걱정/염려'라는 뜻. 같은 concern이 문맥에 따라 달라짐.
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 사안/문제 — (B) 걱정/염려: (A)는 'major agricultural concern'(주요 농업 사안/문제), (B)는 'show great concern for'(큰 걱정/염려를 보이다)로 정확히 구분돼요. ← 정답

❌ ② (A) 걱정/염려 — (B) 사안/문제: (A)와 (B)의 뜻이 서로 뒤바뀌어 틀려요.

❌ ③ (A) 사안/문제 — (B) 사안/문제: (B)는 감정인 '걱정'이라 틀려요.

❌ ④ (A) 걱정/염려 — (B) 걱정/염려: (A)는 '사안/문제'라 틀려요.
det.tip: concern = 사안/문제 vs 걱정/염려, 대표적인 다의어예요.

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the condition of being able to be obtained or used"

det.korean: 정의 '얻거나 사용할 수 있는 상태' = availability(이용 가능성).
det.analysis:
✅ ① availability(이용 가능성): '얻거나 사용할 수 있는 상태'라는 정의와 정확히 일치해요. ← 정답

❌ ② scarcity(부족): 이용 가능성과 반대 뜻이라 틀려요.

❌ ③ sustainability(지속 가능성): 지속성을 뜻해 정의와 맞지 않아요.

❌ ④ productivity(생산성): 생산 능력을 뜻해 정의와 달라요.
det.tip: able to be obtained or used(얻거나 사용 가능한) → availability

questions.passage: Since only 44 percent of the country's agricultural land is __________ (irrigate), millions of rice growers must rely on annual monsoons.
questions.stem:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

Since only 44 percent of the country's agricultural land is __________ (irrigate), millions of rice growers must rely on annual monsoons.

det.korean: irrigate(원형) → irrigated. 'is ___'로 수동태(be+과거분사)를 만들어야 함.
det.analysis: 주어는 'agricultural land'(농경지)로, 물을 '대어지는' 대상이에요. be동사 is 뒤에서 수동태(be+과거분사)를 만들어야 하므로 irrigate의 과거분사 irrigated를 써서 'is irrigated'(관개된다)가 돼요.
det.tip: 수동태 be + 과거분사 → is irrigated

questions.passage: Another innovation: Substantial progress has been made in __________ (develop) hybrid rice varieties that grow faster while using less water.
questions.stem:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

Substantial progress has been made in __________ (develop) hybrid rice varieties.

det.korean: develop(원형) → developing. 전치사 in 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 함.
det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 전치사 in이 있어요. 전치사 뒤에는 명사나 동명사(-ing)가 와야 하므로 develop에 -ing를 붙인 developing(개발하는 것)이 돼요. 'in developing hybrid rice'(잡종 벼를 개발하는 데)라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: 전치사(in) 뒤에는 동명사(-ing) → in developing

questions.passage: Water availability is a major agricultural concern in India, especially for cultivation of rice. Since only 44 percent of the country's agricultural land is irrigated, millions of rice growers must rely on annual monsoons. Over the past 30 years, though, India's farmers have faced challenges as extreme weather events during the monsoon season—including droughts—have become more frequent. Water-use plans are one tool being used to help thirsty regions. In 2009, the Indian government began a national watershed management program to promote more efficient water use through education and __________. Another innovation: Substantial progress has been made in developing hybrid rice varieties that grow faster while using less water. A new drought-resistant basmati rice variety matures about 30 days earlier than previous crossbred varieties. Farmers across India are already praising the high-yielding variety.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: technical support(기술 지원) — 교육과 함께 효율적 물 사용을 돕는 수단.
det.analysis:
❌ ① farmers have(농부들은 ~가 있다): 빈칸 자리에 맞지 않는 구라 틀려요.

✅ ② technical support(기술 지원): 원문 'through education and technical support'(교육과 기술 지원을 통해)에 나오는 표현이라 맞아요. ← 정답

❌ ③ political reform(정치 개혁): 본문에 없는 내용이라 틀려요.

❌ ④ public awareness(대중 인식): 본문에 언급되지 않아 틀려요.
det.tip: education and technical support = 교육과 기술 지원

Since only 44 percent of the country's agricultural land is irrigated, millions of rice growers must rely on annual monsoons. Over the past 30 years, though, India's farmers have faced challenges as extreme weather events during the monsoon season—including droughts—have become more frequent. Water-use plans are one tool being used to help thirsty regions. In 2009, the Indian government began a national watershed management program to promote more efficient water use through education and technical support. Another innovation: Substantial progress has been made in developing hybrid rice varieties that grow faster while using less water. A new __________ basmati rice variety matures about 30 days earlier than previous crossbred varieties. Farmers across India are already praising the high-yielding variety.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: drought-resistant(가뭄에 강한) — 30일 더 일찍 익는 새 바스마티 쌀 품종의 특징.
det.analysis:
❌ ① been(있었다): 품종을 꾸미는 말로 맞지 않아 틀려요.

❌ ② heat-sensitive(열에 민감한): 가뭄에 강하다는 맥락과 반대라 틀려요.

✅ ③ drought-resistant(가뭄에 강한): 원문 'drought-resistant basmati rice variety'(가뭄에 강한 바스마티 쌀 품종)에 그대로 나와요. ← 정답

❌ ④ slow-growing(느리게 자라는): 더 일찍 익는다는 장점과 반대라 틀려요.
det.tip: drought-resistant = 가뭄에 강한, 물 부족 지역에 유리한 품종이에요.
